title: Acceptance-floor shared case table (block 8d-1)
note: Expectations computed by the reviewed 8b census instrument (censusOne + projectLadder) restricted to the rostered classes (D1-D13 + D1s; D14/D15 are registry-scoped, D1n/D1a referred), with the shipped §3 part-2 decision applied over its projection. Engines must reproduce every row. AMENDED 2026-08-20 (F-O1-13): the B1 shape-cell pair is authored from the ruled outcome rather than generated by the 8b census instrument, which the corpus lab's deletion took with it; the 66 cells above it are unchanged and still carry that instrument's provenance. B1 is the boolean-literal Schema Object spelling: legal on the 3.1 line, whose Schema Object IS a JSON Schema 2020-12 schema, and not a Schema Object at all on the 3.0 line, whose Wright Draft 00 subset grants a boolean only at `additionalProperties`. The pair pins the DISPOSITION the ruling settles — the defect confines to the request media alternative that owns it, accounted `invalid`, while the operation survives on its sibling alternative and the source is accepted. It is never a whole-source refusal.

mechanisms.name: D4 costs every REACHING unit its schema (P2 climbs)
D4 does NOT fire where no $ref descends into the defective map
D10 path-level parameter invalidates every operation under the path item (P1)
D6 yields ONE projection entry on each reaching unit; the operation survives
D11 yields a projection entry on the reaching unit only
D11 at a position NO unit reaches yields nothing at all (tier 1)
a REQUIRED body whose every declared alternative is invalid is EXCLUDED, not represented
an OPTIONAL body with the same defect is still represented
